cases.purpose: Versioned 0.1.4 live-ring parity: preserve every original read, priority/level filter, raw/notime rejection, decoded facility, clear-point and unprivileged read/clear/ring-retention observation. The candidate-only fixture hook is mandatory in the paired qualification-014-dmesg-hook-r2 contract.
cases.oracle: Pinned util-linux 2.41.5 on the actual shared guest ring. BASHDMESG_DEV_KMSG_FILE is not an interface of util-linux; its separately controlled invariant is mandatory in qualification-014-dmesg-hook-r2.
cases.comparison: Byte parity of status, stdout and stderr: one line per invocation with its status, stdout and the diagnostic minus any "NAME: line N: " shell-location prefix; the user-facility ring contents read by util-linux after each clearing step. Timestamps are suppressed with -t. The ring is shared by both sides, so each side clears and reseeds it first.
cases.script:
strip() { /usr/bin/sed -E 's/^[^:]*: line [0-9]+: //' "$1" | /usr/bin/tr '\n' '|'; }
show() { printf '%s status=%s out=' "$1" "$2"; /usr/bin/tr '\n' '|' < /tmp/rf.out; printf ' err='; strip /tmp/rf.err; echo; }
r() { local l=$1; shift; "$@" >/tmp/rf.out 2>/tmp/rf.err; show "$l" $?; }
u() { local g=--clear-groups; [[ $3 ]] && g=--groups=$3
  /usr/bin/setpriv --reuid=2000 --regid=2000 $g -- "$BASH" --noprofile --norc -c "$2" >/tmp/rf.out 2>/tmp/rf.err; show "$1" $?; }
lvl=$(/usr/bin/cut -f1 /proc/sys/kernel/printk)
trap 'echo $lvl > /proc/sys/kernel/printk' EXIT
seed() { local m; for m; do printf '%s\n' "$m" > /dev/kmsg; done; }
ring() { echo "  ring: $(/usr/bin/dmesg -f user -t | /usr/bin/tr '\n' '|')"; }
/usr/bin/dmesg -C || echo SETUP-FAILED
seed '<14>rf-seed: info record one' '<11>rf-seed: error record two' '<12>rf-seed: warning record three' '<13>rf-seed: notice record four'
r user dmesg -f user -t
r levels dmesg -f user -t -l err,warn
r raw dmesg -f user -r -t
r decode dmesg -f user -x -t
r kernel-only dmesg -k -t -l emerg
r clear dmesg -c -f user -t; ring
r after-clear dmesg -f user -t
seed '<14>rf-seed: kept record'
u read-unprivileged "dmesg -f user -t"
u clear-unprivileged "dmesg -c"; ring

cases.purpose: Mandatory companion to live-ring r2. The candidate file-hook read-clear must preserve the fixture, emit its exact message, and never invoke syslog(2).
cases.oracle: Independent pinned seccomp filter kills a util-linux dmesg -C negative control with SIGSYS. The unprivileged capability-free candidate file read must return 0 and exact hook record output, preserving input bytes.
